claims.text: Semaglutide (Wegovy) for noncirrhotic MASH with moderate to advanced fibrosis: maintenance 2.4 mg SC once weekly, lowered to 1.7 mg once weekly if not tolerated.
claims.quote: The recommended maintenance dosage of WEGOVY injection for the treatment of noncirrhotic MASH with moderate to advanced liver fibrosis in adults is 2.4 mg injected subcutaneously once weekly. If patients do not tolerate the maintenance dosage of 2.4 mg once weekly, the dosage can be decreased to 1.7 mg once weekly.
